_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Subcontractor Management Plan
summary: Describes the contractor's overall approach to ensuring contract compliance and insight into all subcontracts, including flow down to subcontractors listed on the DD254.
use_relationship:
The Subcontractor Management Plan (SMP) provides contractor's overall approach to ensuring contract compliance and insight into all subcontracts. The SMP will also provide Contractor flow down to all Subcontractors listed on the DD254.  The SMP is used to identify the contractor's management process for their subcontractors, vendors, and suppliers.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content, and intended use for the data product resulting from the work task described in the contract Statement of Work/Performance Work Statement.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Contents
preparation_instructions.content: The Subcontractor Management Plan shall be organized into the following sections:

children.title: Scope
children.content: This section shall be divided into the following sub-sections:

children.title: Table of contents
Describe overall subcontractor roles and responsibilities
Describe Contractor's approach to manage subcontractor's performance
Describe Subcontractor funding and funds management for each subcontractor
Describe applicable subcontractor's Earned Value Management (EVM)
Provide subcontractor schedule
Provide subcontractor (CPI) initiatives
Describe Subcontractor Quality Assurance for each subcontractor
Subcontractor Quality Management System (QMS)
Describe Subcontractor Risk Management Program for each subcontractor
Provide details on how incorporation of quantitative, testable requirements in subcontracted equipment specifications
Define integration of the subcontractor's plans into Contractor schedules
children.content: and monitoring the subcontractor's staffing plans, to include the execution of those staffing plans.

children.title: Define the process to review subcontractors' predictions and analyses for accuracy and correctness of approach
Define the process of furnishing to subcontractors and suppliers with data from testing or usage of their product when testing and usage are outside their control
Define the process to review subcontractors' test plans, procedures, and reports for correctness of approach and test details and consistency with the requirements in the contract SOW
Define the process to review subcontractors' progress reports
Describe the process for Government and contractor's right to monitor and evaluate subcontracted activities
Describe how subcontractors/suppliers shall provide the necessary technical and administrative assurance for their products

Provide verification process for all design disclosure technical data obtained from subcontractors, suppliers, and vendors meet the requirements of the contract SOW and applicable Contractor Data Requirement List (CDRL)
Provide contract CDRL flow down for each subcontractor

Define the process for conducting or controlling their subcontractor/supplier's qualification and acceptance tests to provide a basis for determining the supplier's contractual compliance with contract technical requirements
Define the process to ensure integration of the subcontractor's plans into appropriate schedules
Define the process for monitoring subcontractor-staffing plans
Provide insight on how special attention shall be applied to the technical accomplishment of the subcontractor's critical tasks
Provide flow down VWE/CDE, IA, Data Rights, and PPP requirements to Subcontractors/Suppliers
Define the process to ensure that product support data from subcontractors is incorporated in the Logistics Product Data (LPD) database
Detail subcontractor participation in technical reviews and working groups
Provide subcontractor DD254s for government contractor approval
Provide subcontractor DD254s which do not require government contractor approval for Government awareness
